title: Rav Chisda bar Avdimi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Berakhot 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.53b.8): “Come and hear: Rav Chisda bar Avdimi said, ‘The cedars did not overshadow it,’ and Rava said,” etc. Hyman reports the reading R. Yitzchak bar Avdimi in Dikdukei Soferim and compares [Shabbat 77b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.77b.2).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Berakhot has ארזים (“cedars”) where the supplied notice has ארוים. The same verse is discussed in Shabbat by Rav Yitzchak bar Avdimi. Compare [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1557&lang=en) for the Berakhot attribution.
